llm.summary: This is a scoped Chinese K12 chemistry lesson-planning skill that uses class teaching data to draft teacher-reviewed lesson plans, with disclosed privacy, exam-confidentiality, crisis, and lab-safety limits.

dimensions.detail: The skill depends on platform memory and file capabilities and reads class profile, weakness ranks, student tiers, review plans, exam blueprints, item statistics, and interaction logs; this is proportionate to teacher lesson planning and the schema narrows writes to lessonPlans only.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The package consists of Markdown reference files and a JSON schema; no executable files, install scripts, remote payload retrieval, or tool-wrapping behavior were found.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Activation is limited to chemistry lesson design, outputs are described as teacher-reviewed drafts, exam content restrictions are explicit, and the skill includes safety boundaries rather than hidden or unrelated instructions.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: Persistence is disclosed through platform memory conventions and privacy controls, with view/correct/delete/pause/no-share/export commands; writes are described as pending teacher confirmation rather than automatic background changes.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose and artifact content align: it helps chemistry teachers draft lesson plans around macro/micro/symbolic representations, handles review and exam-commentary classes, and explicitly routes experiments, tests, homework, parent communication, and non-chemistry work to other skills.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install this for Chinese-language, mainland China K12 chemistry teaching contexts where teachers are expected to review AI-generated lesson drafts. Do not deploy it unchanged for other regions or languages without localizing curriculum assumptions, emergency contacts, legal references, and data-consent rules.
llm.findings:
[AE4] expected: The flagged files use Chinese text and typographic punctuation consistent with the skill's documented locale; inspection found no non-whitespace control or format characters in the flagged files.
[SQP-3] expected: The Chinese-only and mainland China locale assumptions are explicitly documented in platform conventions and crisis guidance; this is a deployment-scope limitation to consider, not hidden behavior.
